result.instructions: Tools for Kiwify, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What were my sales and revenue for the last 30 days?"; "Show the order details for the most recent sale."; "Which of my products had the most sales this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kiwify data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kiwify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kiwify_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kiwify_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kiwify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kiwify_get_account
tools.title: Get account details
tools.description: Get the Kiwify account details for this store. Kiwify API: GET /v1/account-details.

tools.name: kiwify_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List all products in the store, with pagination. Kiwify API: GET /v1/products.

page_size.description: Records per page, as the API accepts it. Default set by Kiwify.

tools.name: kiwify_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product's details by its product id. Kiwify API: GET /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: kiwify_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List sales (orders) created between start_date and end_date, with pagination. The window is at most 90 days. Optionally filter by last-update dates. Kiwify API: GET /v1/sales.

start_date.description: Start of the creation window, ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01 00:00:00.000. The window between start and end is at most 90 days.

end_date.description: End of the creation window, ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01 00:00:00.000. The window between start and end is at most 90 days.

updated_at_start_date.description: Only sales updated from this date, ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01 00:00:00.000.

updated_at_end_date.description: Only sales updated until this date, ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01 00:00:00.000.

page_size.description: Records per page, as the API accepts it. Default set by Kiwify.

tools.name: kiwify_get_sale
tools.title: Get sale
tools.description: Get one sale (order) with its buyer and payment details, by order id. Kiwify API: GET /v1/sales/{id}.

tools.name: kiwify_get_sales_stats
tools.title: Get sales statistics
tools.description: Get sales statistics for the store, optionally for a date range. Kiwify API: GET /v1/stats.

start_date.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01 00:00:00.000.

end_date.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01 00:00:00.000.

tools.name: kiwify_list_scheduled_installments
tools.title: List installment plans
tools.description: List Kiwify installment plans (Parcelado) of the store, created between created_start and created_end (at most 90 days). Read only. Kiwify API: GET /v1/scheduled-installments.

created_start.description: Start of the creation window, ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01 00:00:00.000. The window between start and end is at most 90 days.

created_end.description: End of the creation window, ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-01 00:00:00.000. The window between start and end is at most 90 days.

product_id.description: Only plans for this product id.

offer_id.description: Only plans for this offer id.

payment_method.description: Payment method filter, as the API accepts it.

status.description: Plan status filter, as the API accepts it.

customer.description: Customer filter, as the API accepts it.

page_size.description: Records per page, as the API accepts it. Default set by Kiwify.

tools.name: kiwify_get_scheduled_installment
tools.title: Get installment plan
tools.description: Get one installment plan and its installments by plan id. Kiwify API: GET /v1/scheduled-installments/{id}.

tools.name: kiwify_list_balances
tools.title: List balances
tools.description: List all balances of the account. Kiwify API: GET /v1/balance.

tools.name: kiwify_get_balance
tools.title: Get balance
tools.description: Get the balance of one legal entity. Kiwify API: GET /v1/balance/{legal_entity_id}.

tools.name: kiwify_list_payouts
tools.title: List payouts
tools.description: List withdrawals (payouts) of the account, with pagination. Read only. Kiwify API: GET /v1/payouts.

page_size.description: Records per page, as the API accepts it. Default set by Kiwify.

tools.name: kiwify_get_payout
tools.title: Get payout
tools.description: Get one payout (withdrawal) by its id. Kiwify API: GET /v1/payouts/{id}.

tools.name: kiwify_list_affiliates
tools.title: List affiliates
tools.description: List the store's affiliates, with pagination and filters. Kiwify API: GET /v1/affiliates.

status.description: Affiliate status filter, as the API accepts it.

product_id.description: Only affiliates of this product id.

search.description: Search text, e.g. a name or email.

page_size.description: Records per page, as the API accepts it. Default set by Kiwify.

tools.name: kiwify_get_affiliate
tools.title: Get affiliate
tools.description: Get one affiliate's details by affiliate id. Kiwify API: GET /v1/affiliates/{id}.

tools.name: kiwify_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the store's webhook endpoints, with pagination and filters. Kiwify API: GET /v1/webhooks.

product_id.description: Only webhooks for this product id.

search.description: Search text, e.g. the webhook URL.

page_size.description: Records per page, as the API accepts it. Default set by Kiwify.

tools.name: kiwify_get_webhook
tools.title: Get webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook endpoint's configuration by webhook id. Kiwify API: GET /v1/webhooks/{id}.
